title: Task Result v2
description: Worker output contract. Emitted inside <<<TASK_RESULT_V2>>> fences.

task_id.description: Task ID matching the current manifest task.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of what happened.

changed_files.description: Relative file paths changed by the proposed work.

writes.description: Proposed file write operations applied by the orchestrator.

failure_class.description: Optional worker-supplied hint. The orchestrator still owns final classification. Bare classes are valid; subtypes are encoded with colon notation (e.g. transient_infra:api_auth_blocked, transient_infra:node_version_missing) for healer routing. See the Healing Model section of the skill spec for the canonical taxonomy and per-subtype healer responses.

path.description: Relative normalized path. MUST NOT escape the workspace root.

content.description: Inline file content to be applied by the orchestrator.

content_ref.description: Path to staged content written by the worker tooling instead of inline content.

sha256_before.description: Optional precondition hash for conflict detection.

commands.description: Commands the worker claims to have run.

log_refs.description: Relative log references produced by the worker.
